name: Subaru Aster
source:
"What they want is ‘salvation.’"

A boy with jet-black hair and deep blue eyes reminiscent of the night stars. He is the leader of a religious organization called the Aster Faith. A gentleman who carries a dignified nobility and vast knowledge but also has an emotional side.

[Translated from [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/qualiadelta/chara01.html]the official website[/url].]
